data.title: Why Papertrade Won't Let PAPER Trade

data.title: Onchain Inference Markets Post Record Token Usage
data.summary_raw: Surplus usage rose ~2.3x in under a month to a record 312.6B tokens on Oct 18, as rivals' volumes climb and critics demand dollar figures.

data.title: CFTC Tells Court CME Can't Challenge U.S. Perps
data.summary_raw: The CFTC says CME can't sue over U.S. perps because it hasn't been hurt, pointing to a 23% rise in CME's own crypto futures volume since May.

data.title: ZachXBT Flags $20M XMR Laundering Ring on Hyperliquid
data.summary_raw: More than 87% of inflows to FreedomXMR, a Monero swap service on Hyperliquid Core, came from illicit activity, with $20M+ traced to hacks and ransomware.
